name: Node.js
description: Installs Node.js from nodejs.org, verified against the Node.js release signing keys, with Corepack in place of npm.

version.description: Node.js version to install. Use "lts" for the newest long-term support release, "latest" for the newest release of any line, a release line such as "24" or "24.19", or an exact version such as "24.19.0".

corepack.description: npm version specifier of Corepack to install globally, or "none" to leave Corepack out.

keepNpm.description: Keep the npm and npx executables that ship with the Node.js distribution. When false, both are removed so the package manager comes from the project's "packageManager" field through Corepack.
